diagnostics.element_theory: Timoshenko (Euler-Bernoulli when shear areas are absent)
diagnostics.shear_area_rule: Explicit AY/AZ; otherwise Cowper rectangular coefficient times AX when YD and ZD are supplied; no shear when neither is supplied.

classification.method: canonical geometry and axial/moment-released vertical splice levels
classification.assumption: Global Y vertical; one assembly; stack horizontals coincide with released axial splice ends. Supply profile_member_ids for other role conventions.
